artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New module, standard library only (hmac, hashlib, json, datetime). stamp() returns a copy with mark_at (UTC from now) and mark (HMAC-SHA256 over object_id, kind, mark_at and the canonical JSON of the payload without mark and mark_at). verify() returns ok, no-mark, bad-mark (hmac.compare_digest) or stale-mark (more than 15 minutes back or 5 minutes forward). KINDS = (sms.reply, owner.text). No AWS call; not deployed.

Imports ingress_mark as im; _stamp(object_id, kind, payload) helper = im.stamp(a.secret(a.NAMES[secrets][ingress_mark]), ..., a.now_utc()). The four producer sites stamp: _route_commands owner.text (line 1303 at 7af9d5d1f4), _route_commands sms.reply (line 1327), on_owner_text sms.reply (line 1006), on_owner_reply sms.reply (line 1050). dispatch() runs the gate first for sms.reply and owner.text: _mark_mode() reads INGRESS_MARK_MODE at call time (unset or empty is off; an unknown value raises ValueError); _mark_refused() verifies, refuses a replayed mark as replayed-mark, records each failed check in state mark_refusals (last 50, reason and time only) and counts unmarked_seen; enforce returns unmarked-refused before any route runs; record counts and acts; off does not read the secret. marks_seen keeps the last 100. No AWS call; not deployed.

One row added to secrets: ingress_mark = teams/global/ingress-mark. The commit-time naming gate read it: NAMING CONFORMANT data/transcripts/scripts/teams_chat/NAMES.json:86 as SECRET. The secret resource is not created here (cell CA-j-2).

Fakes seeds the ingress secret cache (monkeypatch.setitem on assist._SECRETS, MARK_KEY stand-in) so no test reads AWS. Helpers unmarked(payload) and mark_verifies(sent). test_route_text_only_from_the_owner_and_by_tag now checks the original fields, the mark_at of the fixed clock, and that the mark verifies for the ingress sms.reply, the owner.text and the #0 route. test_several_tagged_replies_in_one_text asserts only the action and event id, so it is unchanged and still passes. Measured: 64 passed in this file (I2-REGRESSION).

New file, 17 tests, all pass (0.29 s): kinds; stamp/verify round trip; stamp returns a copy and changes no input; a naive clock reads as UTC; tamper (action, object id, kind, secret, mark_at, mark type) is bad-mark; no-mark when either field is absent; stale window 15 minutes back and 5 minutes forward with the boundaries; the handler re-sends of on_owner_text and on_owner_reply are stamped and verify; enforce acts on a marked event and refuses unmarked, tampered, stale and replayed events, changing nothing; enforce refuses an unmarked owner.text; record acts and counts; off is today's behaviour and never reads the secret (unset and empty); an unknown mode raises on a text event; the refusal list is capped at 50 and the mark list at 100.
